key_insight: QDiff tests quantum software stacks by comparing output distributions across semantics-preserving program variants.
engineering_relevance: It helps validate quantum compilers and execution pipelines while reducing costly hardware runs through circuit filtering.
method: Generate equivalent program variants using semantics-preserving source transformations.
Filter hardware executions using circuit depth, two-qubit operations, gate error rates, and T1 relaxation time.
Compare output distributions with extensible checks such as Kolmogorov–Smirnov tests and cross entropy.
evidence_signal: The abstract describes the testing approach but reports no benchmark counts, bugs found, or measured speedups.
watch_item: Probabilistic outputs and hardware noise require careful calibration of distribution-comparison thresholds to avoid false alarms.
paper_title: QDiff: Differential Testing of Quantum Software Stacks
